citation: Powell, D. R., Diamond, K. E., Burchinal, M. R., & Koehler, M. J. (2010). Effects of an early literacy professional development intervention on Head Start teachers and children. Journal of Educational Psychology, 102(2), 299-312. https://doi.org/10.1037/a0017763
report_number: Journal article (Journal of Educational Psychology, American Psychological Association). DOI 10.1037/a0017763; ERIC EJ884844. IES-funded grant R305M040167 ('Classroom Links to Early Literacy', Purdue University w/ Michigan State). No IES/NCEE report number and no EEF project.
design: Cluster-randomized RCT; assignment at the teacher/classroom level, stratified by location and intervention semester. 88 Head Start teachers / 759 children across 24 centers in 5 programs (urban, small-city, rural) in a Midwest state. Intervention = 'Classroom Links to Early Literacy', a one-semester (~15-week) early-literacy PD program: 2-day workshop + 7 individualized expert-coaching sessions, delivered on-site (in-person) OR remotely (video/web hypermedia). The TPD-vs-business-as-usual contrast (fall semester) COMBINES the on-site + remote arms into one intervention group (42 intervention classrooms) vs a wait-listed business-as-usual control (31 control classrooms). The on-site-vs-remote comparison (fall+spring) had NO control group, so neither coaching arm is separately contrasted against business-as-usual. Subject = early literacy/language (Reading). Grade = Pre-K (4-year-olds). Outcomes via 3-level HLM (children in classrooms in centers), pretest-adjusted.
problems: Only ONE TPD-vs-business-as-usual student contrast exists: the COMBINED intervention (on-site + remote) vs control (Table 3, fall). The two coaching delivery arms (on-site, remote) were compared only to EACH OTHER (Tables 4-5, fall+spring), with no control group, so the requested per-arm-vs-control split is not available in the paper -- all extracted effect sizes are the combined-arm-vs-control contrast under row_id 91. Effect sizes use the paper's own reported standardized d (computed by the authors as the intervention-vs-control mean difference divided by the preintervention pooled SD); the impact 'beta' coefficients are in raw test-score points (not standardized). g was obtained as g = J*d using the dfe-based small-sample correction (negligible at these df). g_se/g_var were derived from the reported HLM beta SE rescaled by the paper-implied standardizing SD (= beta/d), keeping g and its SE on a coherent scale and cluster-adjusted (the 3-level HLM accounts for nesting). No ICC reported (not guessed); n_clusters = 73 fall classrooms (42 intervention + 31 control). Primary effects taken from the Intervention x Time (gain/difference-in-differences = pretest-adjusted) column, which the abstract and text headline as the intervention effects; the Intervention-vs-control main-effect-at-posttest d is recorded per-outcome in notes. For Letter knowledge and Concepts about print the paper-implied standardizing SD (beta/d) differs from the Table 2 preintervention pooled SD I computed (letter knowledge implied 16.6 vs pooled 8.2; concepts implied 1.18 vs pooled 1.84), so the authors' d for those two appears standardized on a different SD than the simple Table-2 preintervention pooled SD -- the reported d is used verbatim regardless. Initial sound matching is a BINARY (dichotomized) logistic outcome reported in odds-ratio metric; no standard SMD d is given for the intervention-vs-control contrast, so its g is approximate/low-quality and flagged. Child n reflects the preintervention sample (intervention 345, control 265); ~12.5% of the 759 children had a single timepoint and attrition was 11-16% by condition -- the HLM retained all children with >=1 data point.

effect_sizes.test_name: Initial sound matching (IGDI Alliteration / Get It Got It Go!, dichotomized)
effect_sizes.g_method: APPROXIMATE/low quality. Binary logistic outcome; no SMD d reported for this contrast. g approximated as J*(beta/preintervention-pooled-SD) using Intervention x Time beta=0.15 and pooled preintervention SD=2.71 -> d~0.055; J=0.99858 (dfe=530). g_se = (beta SE 0.26 / 2.71) * J. Use with caution.
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.307 Table 3 (Intervention x Time); means p.307 Table 2
effect_sizes.notes: Get It Got It Go! Alliteration / IGDI initial-sound-matching. ~60% of children scored 0, so the authors DICHOTOMIZED the measure (0 = none/one correct, 1 = two or more correct) and analyzed it with logistic regression (odds-ratio metric); the raw means/SDs in Table 2 are on the original 1-20 scale, not the analyzed dichotomy. No standard SMD d is reported for the Intervention-vs-control contrast (Table 3 leaves the d cells effectively for the continuous metric only; the odds-ratio Intervention x Time effect was ns). g here is a rough continuous-scale approximation and should be down-weighted or excluded centrally. No significant intervention effect.
